$comment: Task-family vocabulary for lessons (scope/families, src/learning/families.ts). Data, not code: adding a board means adding its tags here (or `config.families` in its harness result), never a branch in src/. `benchmarks` maps a ledger benchmark name to its families; `sources` maps an outcome source (exact, then its prefix before ':') to its families.

families.math.reasoning: multi-step mathematical reasoning with a checkable answer
families.instruction.following: answers that must satisfy explicit format or content constraints
families.research.retrieval: answers that need searching or retrieving evidence first
families.forecast.typed: forecasts with typed answers (choice, multi, number, ranking, text)
families.forecast.timeseries: next-value forecasts of a published time series
families.tool-agent.policy: multi-turn tool use under a domain policy
families.code.gen: writing a function or program from a specification
families.code.patch: changing an existing repository so its checks pass
